719-1477-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-1477-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Repeat from step 3.

710-3899-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-3899-8207.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1558-2638-4231-5621-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-5621-7824.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

206-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3240-4050-7316.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

1903-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
1903-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

549-1169-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
549-1169-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-1169-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-4885.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7158.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-2999-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-2999-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

14-141-5686.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

3532-5078-6259-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

997-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2425-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2425-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-2604-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2457-3000-3499-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Squirrel and Insect by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

969-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1617-4831-4983-5358-6106.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Electroduplicate.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6106.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6106.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

851-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

215-1432-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-1432-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Ioreth of the Healing House any number of times.

1636-4312-4532.notablePrerequisites:
Psychotrope Thallid has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4312-4532.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Psychotrope Thallid.
Activate Psychotrope Thallid's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Psychotrope Thallid if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo, and you may also optionally sacrifice the Saproling tokens to Psychotrope Thallid's ability if mana permits.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Archfiend of Despair

2607-2682-3908.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2607-2682-3908.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2703-2816-4659-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
2703-2816-4659-4893.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2556-2963-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

539-1512-1636.notablePrerequisites: Stonybrook Schoolmaster does not have summoning sickness.
539-1512-1636.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {G}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
The Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2438-4191-5220-5255.description:
Cast Soaring Show-Off by paying {0}.
Soaring Show-Off enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Soaring Show-Off.
Soaring Show-Off dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Soaring Show-Off on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Soaring Show-Off trigger from step 2, causing each player to draw a card.
Repeat.

1328-1367.notablePrerequisites: Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1328-1367.description:
Deal combat damage with the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, casting a copy of Nexus of Fate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling your library.
Repeat each turn.
